title: Kan et boligområde designes som et levende system?
summary: Økotun er et ubebygd norsk boligkonsept. Et flerspråklig søk i permakultur, cohousing, satoyama og landskapsforvaltning flyttet spørsmålet fra grønne enkelttiltak til relasjoner, arbeid og ansvar over tid.

nb.title: Kan et boligområde designes som et levende system?
nb.summary: Økotun er et ubebygd norsk boligkonsept. Et flerspråklig søk i permakultur, cohousing, satoyama og landskapsforvaltning flyttet spørsmålet fra grønne enkelttiltak til relasjoner, arbeid og ansvar over tid.

en.title: Can a neighbourhood be designed as a living system?
en.summary: Økotun is an unbuilt Norwegian housing concept. A multilingual search through permaculture, cohousing, satoyama and landscape stewardship shifted the question from green features to relationships, labour and responsibility over time.

fr.title: Peut-on concevoir un quartier comme un système vivant ?
fr.summary: Økotun est un concept norvégien d’habitat qui n’a pas encore été construit. Une recherche multilingue sur la permaculture, l’habitat participatif, le satoyama et la gestion des paysages a déplacé la question des équipements « verts » vers les relations, le travail et les responsabilités dans le temps.

de.title: Lässt sich ein Wohnquartier wie ein lebendes System gestalten?
de.summary: Økotun ist ein bislang ungebautes norwegisches Wohnkonzept. Eine mehrsprachige Recherche zu Permakultur, Cohousing, Satoyama und Landschaftspflege verschob die Frage von grünen Einzelmaßnahmen hin zu Beziehungen, Arbeit und Verantwortung über die Zeit.

ja.title: 住宅地を「生きたシステム」として設計できるか
ja.summary: Økotun（エコトゥン）は、まだ建設されていないノルウェーの住宅コンセプトだ。パーマカルチャー、コハウジング、里山、景観管理を多言語で調べると、問いは「緑の設備を増やすこと」から、関係・労働・長期的な責任へと移った。

ko.title: 주거단지를 ‘살아 있는 시스템’처럼 설계할 수 있을까
ko.summary: Økotun은 아직 지어지지 않은 노르웨이의 주거 개념이다. 퍼머컬처, 코하우징, 일본의 사토야마, 경관 관리에 대한 다언어 검색은 ‘녹색 요소를 얼마나 넣을 것인가’라는 질문을 관계, 노동, 장기적 책임의 문제로 옮겼다.

title: Mer musikk, lengre liv
summary: Et eldre stereoanlegg kan ha mange musikkår igjen. Riktig tilkobling, reparerbarhet og praktisk kunnskap kan gi en vei tilbake til musikken.

title: What we learn without being taught
summary: Dialect makes cultural transmission audible. Research on norms, socialization and organizational culture shows how patterns can move through homes, peers, schools and workplaces while people keep changing what they receive.

title: Atriet: Et sted begynner å ta form i samtale med AI
summary: Atriet utvikles gjennom menneskelig visjon og arbeid med AI. Et åpent prosjektnotat om Diana, skapende arbeid og veien fra samtale til handling.

title: Når minnet blir en del av nåtiden
summary: Hjernen gjenaktiverer tidligere erfaringer. KI-agenter kan la lagrede erfaringer styre nye valg. I begge tilfeller oppstår et kontrollspørsmål: Hvor kommer denne representasjonen fra – og gjelder den fortsatt?

title: Når ansvaret kommer hjem
summary: Mange unge ønsker selv å endre vanene sine. Rundt dem finnes venner, skjermer, skolekrav og varer som frister. Hva skal til for at de får mer innflytelse over sin egen hverdag – og hvem gir dem muligheten til å øve?

title: Sierra Leone: School meals can give farmers a market
summary: School meals can connect children's need for food with farmers' need for buyers. A WFP account from Sierra Leone opens questions about local purchasing and cooperation.

nb.title: Sierra Leone: Skolemat kan gi bøndene et marked
nb.summary: Skolemat kan knytte barns måltider og bønders behov for kjøpere sammen. En WFP-reportasje fra Sierra Leone åpner spørsmål om lokale innkjøp og samarbeid.

en.title: Sierra Leone: School meals can give farmers a market
en.summary: School meals can connect children's need for food with farmers' need for buyers. A WFP account from Sierra Leone opens questions about local purchasing and cooperation.

fr.title: Sierra Leone : les repas scolaires peuvent offrir des débouchés aux agriculteurs
fr.summary: En Sierra Leone, un récit du PAM montre comment les repas scolaires peuvent relier les besoins des enfants aux débouchés des agriculteurs.

title: En god eier kan også bli en mektig eier
summary: Amediastiftelsen har avtalt å kjøpe Aschehoug. Sparebankstiftelsen DNB bekrefter et nytt lån til kjøpet, samtidig som styret der velger Amediastiftelsens styre. Langsiktighet er begrunnelsen for finansieringen. Hvordan fordeles ansvar og beslutningsmakt når avisutgivelse og forlagsvirksomhet får samme eier?

title: England revisits motorway charging after a pilot awarded no grants
summary: After every applicant withdrew from a grid-upgrade pilot, England proposed a different funding arrangement. Its value will depend on whether the new connections help drivers find charging they can use and afford.

title: What can a bank know about whether care happened?
summary: A federal analysis follows $17.5 billion in activity that financial institutions considered suspicious. Understanding what happened to the money still requires evidence about the care behind the payments.

title: Ask before you buy
summary: Before deciding what to buy for its care services, Hsinchu County asked for knowledge. Its notices show how early questions can give more people a part in shaping the eventual service.

title: Before the System Is Locked In
summary: In the 1970s, Norwegian unions and researchers explored how workers could help shape computer systems. Their experience speaks to today's AI decisions: knowledge of the work needs a place while the important choices are still open.

title: When plans must become care
summary: For an older person who needs care, municipal plans matter through the help received each day. Norway's audit findings call for closer scrutiny of that connection, alongside the legal duty to provide adequate care and correct shortcomings.

title: From farm contracts to school meals: following the money in Cariacica
summary: School-food records in Cariacica, Brazil, let us follow purchases from family-farm associations through invoices and payments. They reveal part of the journey from farm to school, and point to the people whose experience still needs to be heard.

title: Japan’s flexible daycare benefit: finding hours a family can use
summary: Japan's new benefit gives eligible young children access to limited-hours daycare regardless of whether a parent works. Osaka's application process shows what a family must do before those hours can become part of its week.

title: The AI boom can be real. Its financing can still be fragile
summary: AI may save time at work long before its investors recover the cost of building it. The Bank for International Settlements examines how useful technology and vulnerable financing can grow together.

title: Denmark’s greener land plans depend on agreements with owners
summary: Across Denmark, local groups have mapped possible wetlands, forests and changes to farmland. Making those plans work now means reaching agreements with owners, finding skilled staff and following what happens to the land and water.

title: Before, then, if: 25 public experiments worth watching
summary: A few hours of childcare, a restored wetland, a reliable water supply: public initiatives become interesting when we can see what they might change in daily life. These 25 cases offer concrete starting points for following that work.

title: Taiwan is inviting communities to help design the transition
summary: Local energy, materials that can be used again, and technology shaped around daily life: separate Taiwanese calls invite communities and researchers to help decide what comes next. The opportunities are concrete; the benefits remain to be demonstrated.
